children: UK localisation services firm's H1 revenue grew 5.5% yr/yr, driven by higher localisation demand
Adjusted EBITDA nearly doubled yr/yr as profitability improved on cost cuts and higher volumes
Company says H1 growth partly due to one-off catalogue projects unlikely to repeat in H2
Zoo Digital expects FY27 revenue growth and profit progression in line with market expectations
Company does not expect certain one-off H1 projects to repeat in H2
Company says revenue visibility remains limited, focus remains on execution and cash generation
LOCALISATION GROWTH - Higher volumes of localisation services, especially for older catalogue content licensed into new territories, drove revenue increase
COST STRUCTURE - Improved profitability attributed to a more efficient operating model and lower overheads
FASTER DELIVERY SERVICES - Increased uptake of premium and accelerated delivery services contributed to revenue mix shift
The one available analyst rating on the shares is "buy"
The average consensus recommendation for the software peer group is "buy"
